Description: Nominal companion of myszkowski_2018_spmls: SPM-LS (last series of Raven's SPM), 12 items, 499 respondents; text = option chosen (1-8, 7 distractors + key), resp = correct.

Reference: Sirota, M., & Juanchich, M. (2018). Effect of response format on cognitive reflection: Validating a two- and four-option multiple choice question version of the Cognitive Reflection Test. Behavior Research Methods, 50, 2511-2522.

Description: Nominal companion of suarez_2026_statistics: university statistics exam, 431 students, 85-item bank; text = text of the option chosen (Spanish; option order was randomised), resp = correct.

Description: Nominal companion of geography (slepemapy.cz adaptive geography practice, 2012-2015): 10.1M answers, 91,331 learners, 1,458 places; text = id of the place chosen, or dont_know; options offered in trial_options, place names in itemcov_place_name.

Notes: Built from answer.csv (2015-05-21 dump), which data/geography.R scores but drops place_answered. Carries date (inserted) and NA for the rt sentinel itself; the core table rebuild is queued in #2558. Script data/nominal/geography.py.

Description: Nominal companion of cifar10h: CIFAR-10H human labels of the 10,000 CIFAR-10 test images, 2,571 annotators; text = class chosen (10 classes), resp = 1 if it matches the CIFAR-10 label (itemcov_true_category).
Reference: Peterson, J. C., Battleday, R. M., Griffiths, T. L., & Russakovsky, O. (2019). Human uncertainty makes classification more robust. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 9617-9626.
Notes: Non-commercial share-alike (ruled #2655). Same rows as the core cifar10h with resp_raw renamed to text. Script data/cifar10h.py.

Description: SemEval-2013 Task 7 SciEntsBank: grade 3-6 students' written answers to FOSS/ASK science assessment questions, 3,026 students x 195 questions (sparse); text = graders' 5-way accuracy label (correct / partially_correct_incomplete / contradictory / irrelevant / non_domain), resp = 1 if correct, answer_text = the student's answer.
Reference: Dzikovska, M. O., Nielsen, R., Brew, C., Leacock, C., Giampiccolo, D., Bentivogli, L., Clark, P., Dagan, I., & Dang, H. T. (2013). SemEval-2013 Task 7: The Joint Student Response Analysis and 8th Recognizing Textual Entailment Challenge. Proceedings of the 7th International Workshop on Semantic Evaluation (SemEval 2013), 263-274.
Notes: Share-alike. SciEntsBank half only (Beetle under the 100-id floor). id = module_student (students are module-specific, Nielsen et al. 2008); 36 answers with no student number (all of ME_28b) dropped. Commit 5157c69f. Script data/nominal/semeval2013_scientsbank.py.
